test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Considering the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically follows from the statements.

**Statement****:**

All schools are colleges.

All colleges are houses.

All houses are roads.

**Conclusion****:**

I. All schools are roads.

II. All schools are houses.

III. All colleges are roads.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only conclusion I and III follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

All schools are colleges.

All colleges are houses.

All houses are roads.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215c02f6b6074390cb5da4230ff7abbe5377bd7b879c8e11c8cb6541f25a52f9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All schools are roads - True (Because, All schools are comes under the part of roads).

II. All schools are houses - True (Because, All schools are comes under the part of houses).

III All colleges are roads - True (Because, All colleges are comes under the part of roads).

So, All conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
